-- SQL の見本
/* 複数行の
   コメント */
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
    id          BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
    name        VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    email       TEXT UNIQUE,
    created_at  TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    score       NUMERIC(10, 2) CHECK (score >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT fk_team FOREIGN KEY (team_id) REFERENCES teams (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE INDEX idx_users_name ON users (lower(name));

INSERT INTO users (name, email, score) VALUES
    ('Alice', 'alice@example.com', 1.5e2),
    ('O''Brien', NULL, 0);

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT u.id, u.name, t.title,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.id ORDER BY u.score DESC) AS rn
    FROM users AS u
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = u.team_id
    WHERE u.created_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
      AND u.name LIKE 'A%' ESCAPE '\'
      AND u.id IN (SELECT user_id FROM sessions GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 3)
)
SELECT r.*, CASE WHEN r.rn = 1 THEN 'top' ELSE 'other' END AS tier,
       COALESCE(NULLIF(r.title, ''), "fallback") AS title
FROM ranked r
ORDER BY r.rn ASC, r.name
LIMIT 10 OFFSET 20;

UPDATE users SET score = score * 1.1 WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id;
DELETE FROM sessions WHERE expires_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days';
